thread:
alex: Heads up — Console wants a new dashboard tile for routing-policy hit rate (per-route success/failure + sample rate). We need SDKs to optionally emit route metadata and a sampling header so Console can stitch telemetry across layers.

maya: What headers are we asking for? header names + expected values pls.

alex: Proposed minimal shape: `x-rd-route: teamA/routeX` and `x-rd-sample: 0.1` (float 0-1). If header absent treat as unsampled.

sam: Concern: Go's http library canonicalizes header casing (X-Rd-Route) and some proxies strip unknown headers. Also volume: even sampled at 0.1 this could be a lot for high-QPS customers.

jessica: Console needs stable keys. Can we put the event/route in payload telemetry too? But that's heavier. Header approach lets routing proxies add it.

alex: Agreed on casing — we should document canonicalization and use lowercase in wire examples. SDKs should normalize both forms. Also plan default sample rate = 0 (opt-in) for privacy and volume reasons.

lina: Privacy check — route names might contain PII if teams embed identifiers. We should require a sanitize hook in SDKs and a console validation rule (max length, allowed chars).

maya: SDK owners: can we add an opt-in `emit_route_metadata` boolean and `route_sample_rate` float to clients? Py/TS/Go should have same env var support.

sam: +1. For Go we should add helper that sets both `X-Rd-Route` and `X-RD-Route` to handle proxies, or use `http.Header.Add` which handles canonicalization. Also add batching to telemetry so we don't send per-request network calls.

jessica: For Console: we will accept either header or SDK-emitted event. We'll expose a tile that shows sampled rate and extrapolates counts. Need a manifest of route names from SDK so Console can map friendly names.

alex: Rollout plan suggestion: 1) SDK change merged behind feature flag (`EMIT_ROUTE_METADATA=false`) 2) Canaries for internal customers 5% for 24h, monitor traffic and cost 3) opt-in docs + examples 4) GA only after sanitization hooks are enforced.

lina: Logging + audit — add a KMS-safe obfuscation option for route names at SDK level. Must be documented.

sam: Tests: unit tests for header formatting, e2e for canary with Console tile, perf test for telemetry ingestion at 10k rps with 0.05 sample.

maya: SDK owners — pick a consistent env var prefix: `REDWOOD_EMIT_ROUTE_*`. I'll update the Console spec if we lock names.

deploy-bot: CI results: build/pylib-route-meta (green), go-client-route-meta (failing fmt), ts-sdk-route-meta (green). Link: https://ci.redwood.example/build/12345

alex: Thanks — can we get a short PR checklist in this thread for each SDK? I'll compile and send to release channel once we have owners.

jessica: I'll add Console acceptance criteria and a sample tile mock in Figma.

alex: Action items: maya -> doc headers & examples; sam -> Go canonicalization helper + perf plan; jessica -> Console mapping & tile mock; lina -> sanitization requirements. I'll coordinate SDK owners and set a canary date next week. :thumbsup:
